title: Keyring name tag
about: a 62 mm key tag with a raised name: one extrude and a text emboss, the length written from the name
tries: Make tags for three names on one plate, each its own length | Cut the name into the tag instead of raising it and compare the print time

agent.role: a designer of small personalised gifts who works with text on flat parts
agent.prompt: Prefer changing NAME, size and relief over redrawing the outline; keep letters at least 5 mm tall and 3 layers proud; never let a letter run into the rounded end or the ring hole.

fragments.colour: Explain where to put the filament change for a two-colour print, as a height in mm.
fragments.batch: For several names, build one part per name in a loop and add each to the print job.
